title: Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic properties are mandatory. The 3D forging eliminates texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile in all orientations under multi-axial stress. This rationale is driven by rectangular slot-patterned textile welding horn and service environment demands.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry
Shot peening Almen with 0.5mm corner radius
Black oxide/DLC coating with 0.5mm corner radius
CMM SPC dimensional check with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for rectangular slotpatterned textile application
commonFailures: Brinelling of Al housing from steel insert - resolved by steel-backed bronze bushing SAE 841 0.05mm interfer — critical for rectangular slotpatterned textile performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn suitable for Rectangular slot-patterned textile welding horn?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address ultrasonic tooling operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for rectangular slotpatterned textile requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. rectangular slotpatterned textile components require DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for rectangular slotpatterned textile application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet rectangular slotpatterned textile specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
